items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: Joe Alva had a cat rack eye and he only had one good eye

ctx.x: Dark glasses? Dark glasses. Never, never seen without them glasses. Hide that, that eye, you see. That one eye put out a long time ago when he was a kid. And he only had one eye. He was just something like Joe Alva. Joe Alva had a cat rack eye and he only had one good eye, Joe Alva had. He only had one that he, but he could see better with that one eye than a whole lot of them Joe could see with both eyes. He could read. I mean sight reader. Yeah. I don't mean to take a piece of music and spell like a whole lot…
